competency_fulfillment.rationale: Only seed 55's 'Shade 1/2 of the shape' asks the student to read a written fraction and act on it; the other seven samples (e.g. seed 44's 'A shape is divided into 4 equal parts...') all go picture-to-notation, which is thin coverage of the paired 'read and write' verbs.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Of the eight samples, seven exercise deriving notation from a picture (e.g. seed 45's 1/8 item) while only seed 55 requires reading a given fraction ('1/2') and producing a matching representation — an unbalanced split for a competency naming both reading and writing.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Prompts stay to one short sentence, e.g. seed 43's 'A shape is divided into 2 equal parts. 1 part is shaded.', appropriate for grade 2 quarter 4.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Formats span mcq, read_mcq, set_click and cloze (seeds 42-72), giving reasonable surface variety even though the underlying task repeats.

competency_alignment.rationale: This node's eight samples are byte-for-byte identical to sibling node mat_g2_na_q4_0's ('Represent and identify unit fractions...') samples, so nothing in the rendered content distinctly targets 'read and write...fraction notation' as opposed to the neighboring represent/identify competency.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Denominators stay at 2, 3, 4, and 8, all within the grade's expected unit-fraction range, with numerators fixed at 1.
